user.title: Water Leak Detection for Meters
user.description: Tracks the pulses of a cumulative water meter and alerts when water keeps flowing continuously (check toilets, dishwasher, washing machine, water heater, outdoor taps). Set the meter's pulse size so the minimum detectable leak is reported accurately.

data_description.water_meter: The sensor reporting your cumulative meter reading in cubic feet. The integration fires a leak alert when this value keeps climbing continuously.
data_description.quiet_min: The longest pause between pulses that still counts as "water still flowing". Lower catches slower leaks; too low causes false alarms from a shower or toilet flush. Default 45 min.
data_description.limit_min: How long continuous flow must last before a leak is declared and you're alerted. Default 120 min.
data_description.pulse_ft3: Volume per meter pulse. Check the meter's label (e.g. "2 ft³ per pulse"). Controls the smallest leak the cadence method can report.
data_description.stale_min: Alert if no reading arrives for this long — your bridge/receiver has likely lost signal. 0 turns the check off. Default 180 min (3 h).
data_description.notify_service: Service that receives the alert: a notify. service (e.g. notify.telegram), or telegram_bot.send_message to send straight through a Telegram bot. Pick one from the list, or clear it to turn notifications off — alerts still show on the Leak Detected sensor.
data_description.notify_data: Optional JSON merged into every notification call. For a notify. service this is extra provider data, e.g. {"chat_id": "123456"} for Telegram. For telegram_bot.send_message it's Telegram fields, e.g. {"chat_id": "123456"}. Leave empty for the default recipient.

error.invalid_notify: Pick an available notification service (e.g. notify.telegram or telegram_bot.send_message).
error.invalid_notify_data: Notification data must be a valid JSON object, e.g. {"chat_id": "123456"}.
